title: Two Day Tour of Morocco
text: We had a wonderful trip to Morocco with NJAT.  We did the two-day tour of Morocco with an overnight stay in Chef Chaouen.  It was just our family of three on the trip and I would recommend it for a family or small group trip.  The trip included private drivers on all legs of the journey, plenty of bottled water and a private tour guide in both Tangier and Chef Chaouen.  We opted to have NJAT book the lodging in Chef Chaouen - and I was so happy with our stay.  We stayed at a charming dar right in the medina with wonderful views and a lovely rooftop patio. title: Great Tour - Even after Mother-Nature cancelled our ferry ride to Morocco!
text: We booked directly with NJAT because of all the great reviews.  We were not disappointed.  We were picked up in Seville and taken to the ferry.  By the time we got to the ferry, the ferry ride was cancelled due to high winds.  A couple phone calls with NJAT and our driver came back and got us, transported us to another ferry terminal 20 miles east, and got tickets for the next ferry out.  Can't blame the weather, but NJAT was very flexible and helpful.  NJAT did everything over the phone with the ferry operators and we were able to enjoy the ride with no worries. title: Once in a Lifetime Visit
text: This trip was awesome, we were picked up at our hotel in Seville and driven to Tarifa, the driver got the tickets and got us to the front of the line and off we went. In Tangier our guide was waiting at the ferry terminal. Hassan was excellent, part guide, part philosopher, part teacher. He really did a great job giving us a great overview of the history of the region, things we didn't learn with a western education. title: What an amazing experience!
text: My wife, 21 year old son, and I had the most wonderful trip to Tangier and Chefchauen with Not Just a Tourist.  I was a little nervous as my Spanish isn't great and I had never been to Morocco before, but we were in great hands the entire way.  From pickup at 8:00 AM to drop off the following day back in Seville, everything was handled with care. title: 3 Amazing days in Morocco as a solo female traveler!
text:

title: Excellent Service and Attention
text:
